sub_goals.description: Query mismatches: ledger rows whose external_id matches a feed row but settled_amount_cents != amount_cents

sub_goals.description: UPDATE ledger entries to set settled_amount_cents = feed.amount_cents and reconciliation_status = 'reconciled' for mismatched external_ids only

sub_goals.description: Verify no remaining mismatches and that only affected rows changed status; confirm unchanged entries still agree
sub_goals.done_when: Query returning ledger-feed mismatches yields zero rows
